sections.body: Rhizome Springs is an off-grid community on Salt Spring Island, British Columbia. It is a place for people to gather, explore, build, learn, live and grow into new regenerative ways. Through workshops, community development and events, Rhizome Springs operates as a living laboratory for creative and ecological exploration.

sections.heading: What does it mean to live in harmony?

sections.body: At Rhizome Springs, the land is our laboratory, the community our teachers and our bodies the compass. We are dedicated to the ongoing inquiry into how we relate to ourselves, each other and the land we live on. Through the lenses of ecology, creativity and embodiment, we continuously explore what it means to be in reciprocity with the living world around us.

sections.heading: We've just begun planting this seed, would you like to help us tend to it?

sections.body: Rhizome Springs is in early development stages. We are building infrastructure, growing food systems, and creating gathering spaces. If you feel called to be part of this living project, we would love to hear from you.
To seed a future where we live in integrity with ourselves, each other, and nature – and in appreciation of their intricate connections.
To cultivate a living process of inquiry exploring resilient and regenerative forms of community, through the lenses of ecology, creativity and embodiment.

sections.heading: The Land
sections.body:
Rhizome Springs is situated on the south side of Mt. Tuam on Salt Spring Island, within the unceded territories of the Coast Salish peoples. The 20-acre property features old-growth forest, natural springs, meadows, and a growing network of gardens and gathering spaces.

We live off-grid, powered by solar energy and spring water. Our buildings are hand-built using natural materials. We steward this land with care, guided by principles of ecological restoration and permaculture.

sections.heading: We believe in living, working and playing mindfully with ourselves, each other and the land

sections.body: We are committed to cultivating an inclusive, self-sufficient and regenerative community. We value diversity of thought, practice and background. We seek to learn from the land and from each other, honouring both ancient wisdom and creative innovation.

sections.heading: Embodiment
sections.body: Soma: the body experienced from within, at the level of cellular awareness. Through practices of meditation, Contact Improvisation, Body-Mind Centering, dance, yoga, and somatic exploration, we deepen our relationship with our bodies and each other.

sections.heading: Ecology
sections.body: Ecology: the study of organisms and their relationships to the environment. We practice and teach regenerative land management, permaculture design, food forests, seed saving, natural building, and ecological restoration.

sections.heading: Creativity
sections.body: Creativity: the artistic canvas upon which we paint new possibilities. Through residencies, performances, workshops, music, and collaborative projects, we explore making as a pathway to understanding.

sections.heading: Community
sections.body: Rhizome Springs is a co-creation. Every structure has been built by volunteers, every garden tended by community members. We welcome people who want to contribute their skills, energy, and curiosity to this ongoing experiment in living differently.

sections.heading: Selena La Brooy
sections.body: Selena is the founder and steward of Rhizome Springs. Her path has woven through dance, healing arts, herbalism, and ecological building. A certified Rolfer and lifelong mover, Selena's vision for Rhizome Springs grew from a deep passion for community, embodied living, and tending the land.
